contract.goal: Finish and independently review Custode from the preserved interrupted candidate. Read BRIEF.md for the original approved product goal. Inventory, maintenance, backup API and interface already exist; inspect actual code and current evidence rather than rebuilding them. Finish only material remaining integration, recovery/error states and truthful README/guide gaps, then request fresh host checks and a source-based ready review. The preceding independent absence trial stopped during an aborted Codex call; this is a separately authorized recovery, not a continuation with a reset clock. Own reversible decisions, do not ask for routine choices. Preserve protected acceptance and all earlier behavior. No network, dependencies, publication, push or merge.

criteria.title: Inventory API stores valid searchable data across a process restart
Accessible responsive inventory supports create/search/edit and reload
Linked one-off and recurring maintenance has civil-date and durable history semantics
User can schedule and complete maintenance end-to-end
Exact backup/restore is validated, atomic and documented
User downloads and explicitly confirms data replacement in the interface
